availability: Offline modeled-clock diagnostic; original base availability retained, layer cutoff no later than decision. Actual production availability null; native policy admission false. No retrospective historical issuance claim.
checkpoint: Preserve fitted layer coefficients and memberships; deterministic replay is separately reported as layer recomputation, never base refitting. Original absolute saved weights are only hashed with their completed run, never deserialized.
confirmation: All current dates were previously inspected development; a separate untouched/prospective procedure is required.
economic_contract: Not evaluated; forecast magnitude is not direction or executable net utility. A future policy bridge must preserve common target, cost, risk and native timing contracts.
hypothesis: Causal direct movement-size predictions and their interaction with a signed forecast add predictive information beyond signed-only recalibration.

layer_fit.feature_normalization: weighted training-prefix mean/std; zero std becomes1
layer_fit.penalty_basis: Unchanged20 from original Ridge; no tuning
layer_fit.solver: weighted normalized Ridge linear solve using existing Ridge algebra; all coefficients finite
layer_fit.weight: N/(distinct_origins*rows_at_origin); equal total weight per origin; sum weights=N

metrics: Paired row-weighted MAE/MSE/bias/nearest-rank95th absolute error, augmented-minus-raw and augmented-minus-signed-only differences; all scopes and per-origin/day strata.
resource_basis: 14scopes*(20expanding+1frozen)=294snapshots,4small regressions each; predecessor absolute replay24.438s,385MBsampledRSS,38.5MBoutput; input capsule about300MB. At most1360rows and3predictors per regression.
result_rule: Report positive, negative, mixed and unsupported scopes unchanged. No winner selection, retuning, probability interpretation or economic materiality claim from endpoint errors.
reuse_audit: Read original prequential_residual_calibration_v2 and causal_convex_blend_v2; those estimate marginal residual correction or scalar blend, not a matched signed-only versus magnitude-interaction regression. Reuse original clocks/support guards and Ridge algebra; all base artifacts remain untouched.
support_basis: Unchanged qualified residual/convex support and update schedule. Pool all68 within one horizon/base procedure, sharing the identical mature cohort across ablations.
target: original signed midpoint endpoint basis-point return, exact elapsed horizon
training_predicate: Only earlier origin, base fit cutoff before origin, original signed and magnitude forecast availability by layer cutoff and before target maturity, exact original outcome available by cutoff; never current-origin or in-sample base values.

uncertainty.claim: no effective-N, p-value or independent-confirmation claim
uncertainty.refusals: irregular or insufficient origin grid or one full circular block; no interval if degenerate

unsupported: No output or substitute layer where minimum distinct support fails; preserve all68 coverage. Base methods may remain available separately.
